description: This Java class, DittoMessageSubjectValueValidator, is a final immutable validator that checks if a CharSequence matches the NO_CONTROL_CHARS_PATTERN and throws an exception if validation fails. It implements a singleton pattern and extends AbstractHeaderValueValidator.

classes.name: DittoMessageSubjectValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton immutable validator that checks message subject header values for control characters and throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of DittoMessageSubjectValueValidator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates the header value using NoControlCharactersValidator; throws an exception if invalid.
